name: Suncatcher With Crystal Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

Bring vibrant color and charm into any space with this beautifully crafted custom-shaped suncatcher. Reflects light beautifully through the crystal charm, adding magical rainbow effects and vivid colors to any sunny space.

 

  • Two style options:

 - Single Layer Option: 3mm thick high-quality acrylic.

 - Double Layer Mixed Material: A unique combination of 3mm acrylic (Layer 1) and 3mm wood (Layer 2) for a warm, textured look.

 

  • Each suncatcher comes with:

 - A metal hanging chain.

 - A suction cup hook for easy window attachment.

 - Pre-attached with a metal hanging chain, allowing easy and secure connection to the main suncatcher piece.

  • Crystal charm options:

Available in 2 hanging charm types to choose:

 - Round Charm: 3 cm (~ 1.18 in) diameter with 8 cm (~ 3.15 in) chain

 - Rainbow Charm: 3 cm (~ 1.18 in) bottom crystal, total length 16 cm (~ 6.3 in) including chain.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 

Choose from a variety of sizes to best fit your space:

 - 3.54 x 3.54 in ~ 9 x 9 cm

 - 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm

 - 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm

 - 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm

 - 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

 - 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm

 - 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm

The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

UV Printing Technology ensures vibrant, high-resolution images with excellent durability, crisp, colorful details.

 

  • Functional Use:

Perfect for windows, patios, home decor, garden decor, or car rearview mirror charms. Each piece is designed to catch the sunlight and create dazzling reflections with the included crystal charm.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

A thoughtful and visually stunning gift for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, housewarmings, or just because.

Suitable for all ages and anyone who appreciates art, nature, or vibrant window decorations.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Suncatcher , 1 x Crystal Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
